caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure seated with both legs bent and to the side, with her knees pointed toward the viewer. The figure has light skin, rosy cheeks, and long, straight, black hair. She is wearing a dress with a fitted bodice that is bright magenta or purple in color and has a laced-up pattern in the center. The bodice has short sleeves ending just above the elbow, with the sleeves and bodice both in matching shades of magenta. The skirt of the dress is voluminous and appears to be green with blue and gray shading, creating a sense of depth and folds. The figure's shoes are pink and match the tone of her cheeks. The background is a plain, unadorned light beige or off-white, providing a neutral setting that emphasizes the central figure. There are no additional objects, decorations, or background elements present.
title: Doll
